inline_text:
The README listed four directories in the structure and contents sections:

- skills
- recipes
- prompts
- docs

But only skills exists in this repo. The other three do not exist.

This was misleading for anyone who reads the repo and looks for those paths.

This PR removes all references to recipes, prompts, and docs.
